About Our Brand and Products:

Welcome to Squeaky Bottoms, a new wave of marine care created by boaters tired of boring, ineffective cleaners. We offer a complete family of high-performance products that get the job done right, each with a personality of its own. Our crew includes Barnacle Bill’s Butt Buster (a powerful hull cleaner), Deckhand Davy’s Deck Dazzler (a premium teak restorer), and Sudsy Sally’s Super Suds (a versatile all-purpose boat soap). We’re serious about clean boats but believe the products should be as fun as a day on the water.


What Makes Us Different:

Forget generic labels! Our memorable, cheeky character mascots make our products stand out on any shelf and in every social media post. We’re an authentic, small business story that resonates with the boating community. Affiliates aren’t just promoting a product; they’re sharing a brand with a unique personality that customers love to talk about and show off.


How Affiliates Can Earn:

Join our crew and earn a generous 20% commission on every sale you refer! With a 30-day cookie duration, you get credit for any purchases made within a month of a click. We offer competitive, reliable payouts and a high average order value, as customers often purchase multiple products from our complete cleaning system.


How to Promote Us:

Share your unique affiliate link on your blog, social media (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok), YouTube channel, or email newsletter. Create authentic content like product reviews, before-and-after videos, or cleaning tutorials. Our fun branding and effective products make for highly shareable posts that your audience will love and engage with.


Other Information:

We’re here to help you succeed! As a Squeaky Bottoms affiliate, you’ll get access to a library of high-quality photos, ad copy, and marketing materials to make promotion easy. We provide dedicated support to our partners and are committed to building a community of passionate boaters who are proud to be part of the Squeaky Bottoms family.
